article.title: Rapid, deep and precise profiling of the plasma proteome with multi-nanoparticle protein corona

source_scope.laboratory_anchor: Seer, Inc. / Broad Institute of MIT and Harvard
source_scope.measurement_design: five nanoparticle corona conditions plus depleted-plasma control per subject

quantification_contract.source_identifier_resolution: exact source_identifier_resolution row with UNIQUE_HUMAN_CANONICAL_ACCESSION; no ambiguous group splitting
quantification_contract.rank_eligibility: strictly positive finite author-reported value within one subject-particle measurement batch
quantification_contract.na_policy: retain NA as AUTHOR_NA and exclude from rank; no imputation
quantification_contract.zero_policy: retain explicit numeric zero as AUTHOR_EXPLICIT_ZERO and exclude from rank
quantification_contract.depleted_plasma_policy: retain as provenance control but exclude from NP-corona analysis ledger

claim_boundary: This receipt establishes a paper-attached, row-traceable 141-subject NP-corona cohort with 34 uniquely mapped members of the frozen R3 target universe. It improves biological-unit accounting and permits a separately frozen exploratory cohort analysis; it does not create a new laboratory anchor, protected lockbox, independent evaluator, no-author reproduction, or scientific submission readiness.
